method: Figma node exported at 1x; browser element screenshot at dpr 1 from src/css/index.css, wireframe pack; overlaid, difference blend

promotion: An invisible stroke must be a variable that is transparent (action/quiet-fill), never a paint at opacity 0: Figma drops the opacity and draws the line. Also: a page background in the file must be white or the export composites onto canvas grey.
